text: 孙悟空进了八卦炉——越炼越结实
pinyin: sūn wù kōng jìn le bā guà lú —— yuè liàn yuè jiē shi
literal: Sun Wukong · enter · le · Eight Trigrams furnace — more · forge · more · sturdy
natural: Monkey King in Laozi's furnace comes out tougher

meaning.en: Hardship makes a person stronger; trials temper character.
meaning.zh: 孙悟空被太上老君扔进八卦炉，反而炼出了火眼金睛，比喻经受磨炼，人越锻炼越坚强。

equivalents: what doesn't kill you makes you stronger

examples.zh: 他经历了那么多挫折，真是孙悟空进了八卦炉，越炼越结实。
examples.en: After so many setbacks he has only grown tougher.

examples.zh: 年轻人要多吃苦，孙悟空进了八卦炉，越炼越结实。
examples.en: Young people should endure hardship; it toughens them.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From Journey to the West, where Sun Wukong comes out of the furnace with his 'fiery golden eyes'.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。典出《西游记》。

text: 孙猴子的脸——说变就变
pinyin: sūn hóu zi de liǎn —— shuō biàn jiù biàn
literal: Monkey King · 's · face — say · change · then · change
natural: The Monkey King's face changes in a flash

meaning.en: Very changeable; someone whose mood or attitude shifts suddenly.
meaning.zh: 孙悟空会变化，脸色说变就变，比喻人的态度、情绪变化无常。

examples.zh: 你这人就像孙猴子的脸，说变就变，让人摸不着头脑。
examples.en: You change so suddenly that no one can keep up.

examples.zh: 她的态度，孙猴子的脸，说变就变。
examples.en: Her attitude flips in an instant.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Similar in sense to 六月的天——孩儿的脸.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。意思近于“六月的天——孩儿的脸”。

text: 唐僧念紧箍咒——孙悟空头痛
pinyin: táng sēng niàn jǐn gū zhòu —— sūn wù kōng tóu tòng
variants: 孙悟空听见紧箍咒——头痛
literal: Tang Monk · chant · tight band spell — Sun Wukong · head · ache
natural: Tang Monk recites the spell and Monkey's head splits

meaning.en: A restraint or person who always makes someone uncomfortable; a thing that keeps someone in check.
meaning.zh: 唐僧一念紧箍咒，孙悟空就头痛，比喻某人或某事制约着对方，使对方难受。

examples.zh: 老板一开口，我就像孙悟空听见唐僧念紧箍咒，头痛得很。
examples.en: As soon as the boss opens his mouth, I get a headache like the Monkey King hearing the Tang Monk chant.

examples.zh: 妈妈一念叨，唐僧念紧箍咒——孙悟空头痛。
examples.en: When Mum starts nagging, it's like a spell that splits my head.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From Journey to the West, where the headband controls Sun Wukong.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。典出《西游记》。

text: 贾宝玉的玉——命根子
pinyin: jiǎ bǎo yù de yù —— mìng gēn zi
literal: Jia Baoyu · 's · jade — life · root
natural: Baoyu's jade is his life's root

meaning.en: The thing someone treasures most and cannot do without.
meaning.zh: 《红楼梦》中贾宝玉口衔的通灵宝玉，被视为他的命根，比喻最珍贵、最离不开的东西。

examples.zh: 这孩子是她的命根子，贾宝玉的玉，什么都比不上。
examples.en: The child is the apple of her eye.

examples.zh: 这台电脑是他贾宝玉的玉——命根子。
examples.en: This computer is his most precious possession.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. From Dream of the Red Chamber, where Baoyu was born holding a jade tablet.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。典出《红楼梦》。

story.en: In the Dream of the Red Chamber, the jade Baoyu was born with is treated by Grandmother Jia and the household as his very life-root (命根子); losing it nearly costs him his life. The saying draws on this.
story.zh: 《红楼梦》中宝玉衔玉而生，贾母及众人视通灵宝玉为他的“命根子”，失玉则几致丧命。

text: 螃蟹过街——横行霸道
pinyin: páng xiè guò jiē —— héng xíng bà dào
literal: crab · cross · street — sideways · walk · overbearing · way
natural: A crab crossing the street

meaning.en: To throw one's weight around; to act tyrannically.
meaning.zh: 螃蟹横着走路，比喻仗势欺人、蛮不讲理。

examples.zh: 别以为有点权力就能螃蟹过街，横行霸道。
examples.en: Don't think a bit of power lets you lord it over everyone.

examples.zh: 他在村里像螃蟹过街一样，横行霸道。
examples.en: He bullies everybody in the village.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 横行 means both 'walk sideways' (like a crab) and 'run amok'.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“横行”既指螃蟹横着走，也指蛮横行事。

text: 自留地里撒尿——肥水不落外人田
pinyin: zì liú dì lǐ sā niào —— féi shuǐ bù luò wài rén tián
literal: private plot · in · urinate — fertile · water · not · fall · outside · people · field
natural: Watering your own plot means no goodness goes to others

meaning.en: Keep the benefit within the family or group, rather than letting outsiders have it.
meaning.zh: 在自家地里施肥，好处不外流，比喻好处不让别人得到，留给自己人。

examples.zh: 这个工程就交给自己人做，自留地里撒尿，肥水不落外人田。
examples.en: Give this job to our own people; let's keep the money in the family.

examples.zh: 我们公司自留地里撒尿，肥水不落外人田，好处都留给老员工。
examples.en: Benefits stay with the long-serving staff.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Crude humour; the proverb 肥水不落外人田 is more polite on its own.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。此语带粗俗色彩，单说“肥水不落外人田”则较文雅。

text: 抓了芝麻丢西瓜——主次不分
pinyin: zhuā le zhī má diū xī guā —— zhǔ cì bù fēn
literal: grab · le · sesame · lose · watermelon — main · minor · not · distinguish
natural: Picking up a sesame seed and dropping a watermelon

meaning.en: To lose something big for something small; to confuse priorities.
meaning.zh: 捡了芝麻，却丢了西瓜，比喻只顾小利而丢了大利，不分轻重缓急。

equivalents: lose sight of the big picture

examples.zh: 为了省几块钱而误了航班，真是抓了芝麻丢西瓜。
examples.en: Missing a flight to save a few pounds is penny wise, pound foolish.

examples.zh: 他抓了芝麻丢西瓜，主次不分。
examples.en: He can't tell the important from the trivial.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The first half alone (抓了芝麻丢西瓜) is the most common form.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常只说前半句。

text: 属生姜的——越老越辣
pinyin: shǔ shēng jiāng de —— yuè lǎo yuè là
literal: belong · ginger · 's — more · old · more · hot
natural: Like ginger, the older the sharper

meaning.en: Older people grow more capable and shrewd with experience.
meaning.zh: 姜越老越辣，比喻人越老经验越丰富、办法越多。

examples.zh: 别小看老张，他是属生姜的，越老越辣。
examples.en: Don't underestimate Old Zhang; he gets sharper with age.

examples.zh: 爷爷属生姜的——越老越辣，棋艺一点没退步。
examples.en: Grandpa has only got better at chess with age.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Said in praise of elders; 姜还是老的辣 is the proverb it paraphrases.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常用来夸奖老人；意思同俗语“姜还是老的辣”。

text: 属臭豆腐的——闻着臭，吃着香
pinyin: shǔ chòu dòu fu de —— wén zhe chòu, chī zhe xiāng
literal: belong · stinky tofu · 's — smell · zhe · stink, eat · zhe · fragrant
natural: Like stinky tofu: smells awful, tastes great

meaning.en: Rough on the outside but good within; unattractive at first but rewarding.
meaning.zh: 臭豆腐闻着臭，吃起来香，比喻外表不好看，内在很好。

equivalents: don't judge a book by its cover

examples.zh: 他这人属臭豆腐的，闻着臭，吃着香，接触久了才知道他很可靠。
examples.en: He seems rough but is reliable once you get to know him.

examples.zh: 别看这家店破，属臭豆腐的——闻着臭，吃着香。
examples.en: The shop looks shabby but the food is excellent.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 猪八戒戴花——自我欣赏
pinyin: zhū bā jiè dài huā —— zì wǒ xīn shǎng
literal: Zhu Bajie · wear · flower — self · self · admire
natural: Pigsy wears a flower and admires himself

meaning.en: To be pleased with oneself regardless of how one looks.
meaning.zh: 猪八戒头上戴花，自以为很美，比喻自我陶醉、自我欣赏。

examples.zh: 他整天猪八戒戴花，自我欣赏。
examples.en: He spends all day admiring himself.

examples.zh: 别猪八戒戴花——自我欣赏了，先看看大家的反应。
examples.en: Stop admiring yourself and see what others think.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 周郎妙计安天下——赔了夫人又折兵
pinyin: zhōu láng miào jì ān tiān xià —— péi le fū rén yòu zhé bīng
literal: Zhou Yu · clever · plan · settle · world — lose · le · wife · and · lose · soldiers
natural: Zhou Yu's brilliant plan loses both the bride and the army

meaning.en: Losing twice over; a scheme that backfires and costs more than it gains.
meaning.zh: 周瑜用美人计夺荆州，结果孙权妹妹嫁给刘备，周瑜又损兵折将，比喻想占便宜却吃了大亏。

examples.zh: 他想占便宜，结果周郎妙计安天下，赔了夫人又折兵。
examples.en: He tried to cheat his way to a profit and lost on both counts.

examples.zh: 这笔生意周郎妙计安天下——赔了夫人又折兵。
examples.en: That deal cost us both money and reputation.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From Romance of the Three Kingdoms, where Zhuge Liang's men mocked Zhou Yu with this line.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。典出《三国演义》，诸葛亮部下以此嘲笑周瑜。

story.en: In chapter 55 of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Zhou Yu's plot to trap Liu Bei through a marriage to Lady Sun fails, and Zhuge Liang's soldiers shout: 'Zhou Yu's clever plan pacified the realm, but he lost the lady and his troops too' (周郎妙计安天下，赔了夫人又折兵).
story.zh: 《三国演义》第五十五回，周瑜假意招亲之计被诸葛亮识破，蜀军高呼：“周郎妙计安天下，赔了夫人又折兵！”

date.en: late Yuan to early Ming, 14th c.

text: 针尖对麦芒——针锋相对
pinyin: zhēn jiān duì mài máng —— zhēn fēng xiāng duì
literal: needle · point · against · wheat · awn — needle · point · mutually · oppose
natural: Needle point against wheat awn

meaning.en: Two sides are sharply opposed, each point answered by a counter-point.
meaning.zh: 针尖和麦芒都尖，碰在一起，比喻双方观点尖锐对立、互不相让。

examples.zh: 两个人针尖对麦芒，谁也不肯让步。
examples.en: The two were at daggers drawn, neither giving way.

examples.zh: 会上针尖对麦芒，气氛非常紧张。
examples.en: The meeting was a head-on clash and the mood was tense.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Neutral to casual; the second half is a four-character chengyu.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句“针锋相对”本身是成语。

text: 丈母娘看女婿——越看越欢喜
pinyin: zhàng mǔ niáng kàn nǚ xu —— yuè kàn yuè huān xǐ
literal: mother-in-law · look · son-in-law — more · look · more · delighted
natural: A mother-in-law eyes her son-in-law

meaning.en: The more one looks, the better one likes; used of growing affection or approval.
meaning.zh: 丈母娘看女婿，越看越满意，比喻越看越喜欢。

equivalents: grow to like more and more

examples.zh: 这个新员工丈母娘看女婿，越看越欢喜。
examples.en: The boss likes the new employee more every day.

examples.zh: 她对这幅画，丈母娘看女婿——越看越欢喜。
examples.en: The more she looks at the painting, the more she loves it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Usually spoken of something or someone liked, not literally of a mother-in-law.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。多用于喜欢的人或物。

text: 张果老骑驴——倒着走
pinyin: zhāng guǒ lǎo qí lǘ —— dào zhe zǒu
literal: Zhang Guolao · ride · donkey — backwards · zhe · walk
natural: Zhang Guolao rides his donkey backwards

meaning.en: To go against the grain; to do things the opposite way or regress.
meaning.zh: 八仙之一张果老倒骑毛驴，比喻与常规相反，或倒退。

examples.zh: 别张果老骑驴倒着走，跟大家反着干。
examples.en: Don't go against everybody for the sake of it.

examples.zh: 这政策是张果老骑驴——倒着走，越改越差。
examples.en: The policy is going backwards.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Zhang Guolao is one of the Eight Immortals, said to ride a donkey facing backwards.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。张果老为八仙之一，传说倒骑毛驴。

text: 雨后的竹笋——节节高
pinyin: yǔ hòu de zhú sǔn —— jié jié gāo
literal: rain · after · 's · bamboo shoot — section · section · high
natural: Bamboo shoots after the rain grow joint by joint

meaning.en: Rising steadily; improving all the time.
meaning.zh: 雨后竹笋长得快，一节比一节高，比喻不断上升、进步。

examples.zh: 公司的业绩像雨后的竹笋，节节高。
examples.en: The company's results keep climbing.

examples.zh: 他的成绩雨后的竹笋——节节高。
examples.en: His grades keep getting better.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Often said as a wish or compliment (the 'steadily upward' sense).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常作祝福或夸奖。

text: 鹦鹉学舌——人云亦云
pinyin: yīng wǔ xué shé —— rén yún yì yún
literal: parrot · learn · tongue — others · say · also · say
natural: A parrot mimics speech

meaning.en: To repeat what others say without thinking.
meaning.zh: 鹦鹉只会模仿人说话，比喻没有主见，别人怎么说自己也怎么说。

examples.zh: 别鹦鹉学舌，人云亦云，要有自己的看法。
examples.en: Don't just parrot others; form your own opinion.

examples.zh: 他那些话不过是鹦鹉学舌。
examples.en: His words are just repetition.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。

text: 阴沟里翻船——没想到的事
pinyin: yīn gōu lǐ fān chuán —— méi xiǎng dào de shì
literal: covered drain · in · capsize · boat — not · expect · de · thing
natural: A boat capsizing in a ditch

meaning.en: An unexpected failure in an easy situation; being caught out by something minor.
meaning.zh: 在阴沟这种小地方翻了船，比喻在不该出问题的小事上出了意外。

examples.zh: 这么简单的题也错了，阴沟里翻船，没想到。
examples.en: Getting such an easy question wrong was unexpected.

examples.zh: 老手也会阴沟里翻船。
examples.en: Even veterans slip up.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The first half is also used as a phrase for such a mishap.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。前半句也可单独作熟语使用。

text: 一条道走到黑——死心眼
pinyin: yī tiáo dào zǒu dào hēi —— sǐ xīn yan
literal: one · road · walk · until · dark — dead · heart · eye
natural: Following one road until dark

meaning.en: To be stubborn; to refuse to change course.
meaning.zh: 沿着一条路走到天黑也不回头，比喻固执死板，不肯变通。

examples.zh: 你别一条道走到黑，换个办法试试。
examples.en: Don't stubbornly keep going; try another way.

examples.zh: 他一条道走到黑，谁劝都没用。
examples.en: He won't listen to anyone.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Compare 碰到南墙不回头.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。参见“碰到南墙不回头”。

text: 一脚踏两只船——左右为难
pinyin: yī jiǎo tà liǎng zhī chuán —— zuǒ yòu wéi nán
literal: one · foot · step · two · boat — left · right · difficult
natural: One foot in each of two boats

meaning.en: To play both sides; trying to keep two options at once and ending up in a bind.
meaning.zh: 一只脚踩两只船，进退两难，比喻在两边都不想得罪，处境尴尬。

equivalents: have a foot in both camps

examples.zh: 一脚踏两只船，最后左右为难。
examples.en: Straddling two boats, he ended up in a dilemma.

examples.zh: 她一脚踏两只船，很快就露馅了。
examples.en: Playing two sides, she was quickly found out.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The first half alone also implies infidelity or double dealing.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。前半句也常指感情或立场不专一。

text: 一根绳拴俩蚂蚱——谁也跑不了
pinyin: yī gēn shéng shuān liǎ mà zhà —— shéi yě pǎo bù liǎo
literal: one · rope · tie · two · grasshoppers — who · also · run · not · away
natural: Two grasshoppers on one string

meaning.en: Everyone involved is in the same fix; none can escape alone.
meaning.zh: 一根绳上拴着两只蚂蚱，哪一只也逃不掉，比喻命运连在一起，谁也跑不了。

examples.zh: 我们一根绳拴俩蚂蚱，谁也跑不了。
examples.en: We're in the same boat; nobody can get away.

examples.zh: 这事一根绳拴俩蚂蚱，要查都要查。
examples.en: In this affair we're tied together.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。
